title: E(C) reproducibility attestation
description: A committed record that a PINNED E(C) was MEASURED byte-reproducible from its real source (Benchmark C): the source was extracted twice by independent extractor invocations through the same pipeline that produced the pin, and both extractions' canonical bytes were identical AND identical to the pinned E(C). A certificate over a pinned E(C) may set ec_reproducible=true ONLY by citing an attestation whose compared_digest equals the canon semantic-content digest of the exact E(C) being certified (SEMANTICS sec 9, measured or false). Any mismatch -- a different E(C), an edited pin, a malformed attestation -- yields ec_reproducible=false. Deterministic: no wall-clock fields.

subject.description: Stable label of the measured subject (e.g. graphbase).

ec_path.description: Repo-relative path of the pinned E(C) this attestation covers.

subdir.description: Path inside the source checkout that was extracted.

pipeline.description: Repo-relative path of the driver that produced the pin (and was re-run to measure).

pins.description: Extractor package version pins in effect for the measurement.

extraction_digests.description: canon semantic-content digest of each of the two independent extractions.

compared_digest.description: The digest both extractions and the pinned E(C) share. MUST equal the canon semantic-content digest of the E(C) at ec_path.

reproducible.description: Only a successful measurement is recorded; a failed one is never committed as an attestation.
